content.original_pngs: All 15 text PNGs and 3 reference PNGs match the established source hashes.
content.first_sheet: The approved first-sheet typography and material treatment are retained. Its 37-fragment canonical data is byte-identical to the approved archive.
content.later_sheets: The original source glyph silhouettes are used directly, preserving indents, columns, ASCII marks, source cross-outs, existing overlaps, and source cropping. No OCR typesetting or reflow.
content.normalization: All source images fit within 1700 by 2200 without stretching. The wide fourteenth source occupies 1700 by 1114 at the top of its leaf.
content.unique_surfaces: 15 distinct deterministic seeds, palettes, stain fields, marker compositions, and material profiles; 15 distinct front image hashes.

surface.ink: Varied ribbon density, capillary bleed, wet marker cancellations, colour overlap, and pooled pigment.
surface.paper: Shared ink and paper abrasion, irregular chipping, exposed pulp, handled-edge soil, and page-specific stains.
surface.sequence: Quiet sheets alternate with heavier occlusion and cancellation. Original structure remains available through Source page.

page_turn.geometry: Developable cylindrical WebGL surface, two-sided material, pointer-driven curl.
page_turn.material: Printed front, faint transferred reverse, directional lighting, perspective, and moving shadow.
page_turn.runtime: Native WebGL; rendering stops when the sheet settles; no external runtime libraries.
page_turn.implemented_fallbacks: Reduced-motion preferences and unavailable WebGL skip the automatic curl. These branches were reviewed in code, not separately forced in the browser.

browser.page_boundaries: First Previous and last Next disabled.
browser.pointer: Forward drag, backward drag, and short cancelled drag passed.
browser.curl: Curved, two-sided WebGL surface visually inspected during a turn.

limits: Direct file navigation remains unverified because the preview browser permits only HTTP and HTTPS URLs.
No physical phone or Safari-specific test was performed.
Only sheet 01 has a verified full reading transcript. Sheets 02 to 15 have descriptive image alternatives; working OCR is unverified and excluded from the book.
